target_graph_policy: Targets are parsed with hydrogen nodes suppressed while retaining attached-H counts. Query hydrogens are explicit graph nodes in the original SMARTS. Use the actual returned merged SMARTS for matching. The independent intended exact-count criterion is nitrogen H-count2,written[N;H2];this deliberately does not exclude amide nitrogens or require neutral charge.
scope: Controlled graph-query curation for a hydrogen-count annotation;not NMR assignment or reactivity prediction.
